content:
Priya Nair: Heads up — we just got a pile of escalations from support and a monitoring alert: p99 for /v1/generate on hosted region us-west-2 jumped from ~700ms to ~3.2s around 14:11 UTC. Customers noticing timeouts and slow UIs.

Alex Chen: copying infra. Any correlating cluster events? autoscaler? GPU OOMs?

ops-bot: Alert triggered 1801236705: route:/v1/generate p99 latency > 2s for 5m (us-west-2). Instances affected: inf-rt-12, inf-rt-15.

Marta Lopez: Looking at metrics — high queue depth and increased batch sizes around the window. KV-cache hit rate dropped from 82% -> 28% for redwood-7b. Could be cache eviction / prefix invalidation.

Samir Patel: Also seeing a spike in cold-start counts for the lightweight fallback pool. CGPU usage is normal but CPU on routing pods spiked (75% -> 96%). Suspect routing slowdown leading to request queuing and large batches that blow p99.

Li Wei: Repro steps from support: simple chat generation call, temperature 0.7, max_tokens 256, streaming disabled. curl example they sent: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"Summarize...","max_tokens":256}'
```

Priya Nair: Support thread includes a customer-supplied sample that reliably hits the p99 regression. They said it started around 14:10 after a spike in traffic from a partner integration.

Alex Chen: Quick mitigations we can do right now: 1) enable strict per-route rate limiting for the offender account, 2) temporarily enforce a circuit breaker to route heavy requests to a lower-latency model (e.g., redwood-3b), 3) reduce max batch size/flush interval on routing for us-west-2. Which is fastest?

Marta Lopez: Easiest immediate: flip route to prefer redwood-3b for non-enterprise tier or for requests > X tokens. I can patch runtime routing policy now. Patch will take ~2 mins to roll.

Samir Patel: I can push a hotfix to reduce router.max_batch_tokens from 2048->1024 and router.max_wait_ms from 12->6 for the affected pool. That should reduce p99 at cost of some throughput.

Priya Nair: Support wants an ETA to tell customers. If we do both changes, can we expect improvement in 10–15m?

Li Wei: After the patch and rate-limit, we should see p99 drop within a single autoscaler cycle (~5–10m) assuming no more backend regressions.

Alex Chen: Also check fallback/region policy: enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 for new requests if us-west-2 latency > 1.5s for 3 consecutive minutes. Ops-bot can toggle region fallback.

ops-bot: Command to toggle fallback: `ops-bot enable-fallback --from us-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --metric route:/v1/generate/p99 --threshold 1.5s --window 180s`

Marta Lopez: I'll apply the routing policy change now to prefer 3b for non-pro accounts. Posting the patch diff: 

```
- preferred_model: redwood-7b
+ preferred_model: redwood-3b
+ policy: "latency_guardrail"
```

Samir Patel: Hotfix applied: router knobs changed on pool inf-rt-12/15. Reduced batch tokens and flush. Monitoring: queue depth dropping, CPU on routing -> 55% within 3m.

Alex Chen: Rate-limiting applied to offending API key (partner-integ-345). Limit set to 20 reqs/s with a burst of 40. Support notified partner.

Priya Nair: Customer-facing note sent: "We're actively mitigating a latency spike by reducing per-request throughput and routing to a lower-latency model. Expect improved response times within 10–20 minutes. We'll follow up with RCA." :thumbsup:

Li Wei: Current numbers 10m after mitigations: p95 420ms, p99 1.2s (was 3.2s). KV-cache hit rate recovering to ~60%. Traffic shifted to 3b for ~18% of requests.

Marta Lopez: Longer-term RCA steps: 1) investigate why KV-cache had mass eviction — check recent cache invalidation job and model version rollouts, 2) validate router-backpressure path (we're queuing too long before batching), 3) add SLO guardrail that automatically reduces batch size when route p99 > threshold, 4) add a per-region circuit breaker that routes to smaller model or another region.

Alex Chen: We should add automated playbooks: when route p99 > 1.5s for 5m -> (a) reduce routing batch size by 50% (b) enable model-fallback policy (c) apply rate limit at customer/route level (d) open a P1 incident if mitigations don't lower p99 below 1s in 15m.

Samir Patel: I'll draft the automation runbook and a helm config for default guardrail values. Sample YAML for the auto-guardrail: 

```
guardrails:
  - name: latency_p99_guard
    trigger:
      metric: route:/v1/generate/p99
      threshold_ms: 1500
      window_s: 300
    actions:
      - set_router_param: {max_batch_tokens: 1024, max_wait_ms: 6}
      - enable_model_fallback: {to_model: redwood-3b, fraction: 0.25}
      - apply_rate_limit: {scope: route_or_key, rps: 20}
```

Priya Nair: Can we add a notification to the on-call channel and auto-create a support ticket when the guardrail fires? Support needs the customer context immediately.

Alex Chen: Yes — add AlertBot integration to include top offending API keys and recent sample traces. ops-bot can append runbook link.

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/latency-guardrails (shared)

Marta Lopez: For the RCA include: recent deploys in the region (check eng-releases), cache invalidation events, autoscaler logs, routing pod restarts, model upgrades. Assigning follow-ups: 
- Marta: cache eviction investigation
- Samir: router backpressure + automation runbook
- Alex: rate-limit audit + fallback automation
- Priya: customer comms and support tickets

Li Wei: Also recommend a new SLO doc: route-level p99 SLO with automatic mitigation weights. Link I'll draft: https://internal.redwood.ai/slo/route-p99 (will reference in RCA).

Priya Nair: Support updated customers that mitigations are in place and p99 is improved; some customers asked to be whitelisted from fallback — we'll coordinate with product for exceptions.

Marta Lopez: Closing loop: continuing to monitor for 1h. If p99 holds <1s we will mark incident mitigated and start postmortem.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — great cross-team response. Please post logs/traces and timeline to the incident postmortem channel when done. :heart:

AlertBot: Incident 1801236789 marked mitigated at 1801240498.

Priya Nair: Filing ticket with notes and links to runbook and automation YAML.
